content: 1. In the comparison of 1-2 NAAs versus 23 NAAs, the relative risk (RR) in prospective studies was calculated to be 2.07 with a 95% confidence interval (CI) ranging from 1.785 to 2.4. 2. In retrospective studies for the same comparison, the relative risk (RR) was determined to be 1.891 with a 95% confidence interval (CI) of 1.544 to 2.317. 3. When combining the data from both prospective and retrospective studies, the overall relative risk (RR) was found to be 2.006 with a 95% confidence interval (CI) of 1.78 to 2.261. 4. For the comparison of 1-2 NAAs versus 25 NAAs, the overall relative risk (RR) was calculated to be 2.24 with a 95% confidence interval (CI) ranging from 1.345 to 3.73. 5. The number of studies included in the analysis was three for the 1-2 NAAs versus 23 NAAs comparison and five for the 1-2 NAAs versus 25 NAAs comparison.
